productTitle: Textile Lace-Up Casual Sneakers with Rubber Outsole
textDesc: Casual lace-up sneakers with a textile upper, molded decorative overlays and a rubber outsole. Black and Sand color options, listed sizes 38-44. Minimum order: 2 pairs. Send your color and size quantities and destination for order confirmation.
companyDesc: Company capabilities are shown below. Product-specific customization, samples, packing and dispatch arrangements are assessed against your order requirements before quotation.
companyFaqDesc: Which colors and sizes are listed?
Black and Sand, in sizes 38-44. Send the required quantity for each color and size so availability can be confirmed for your order.
Textile upper, molded decorative overlays and rubber outsole. If you need additional material specifications, include them with your inquiry for confirmation.
What are the minimum order and quantity prices?
Minimum order: 2 pairs. 2-49 pairs: USD 18.37/pair; 50-99 pairs: USD 17.14/pair; 100+ pairs: USD 15.92/pair. Freight and order terms are quoted separately.
Can all listed colors and sizes be supplied?
Availability is confirmed against your requested color, size and quantity breakdown before the order is finalized. The listed options are not a guarantee of current stock for every combination.
What is the dispatch lead time?
Send your quantity and required dispatch date. Order-specific availability, packing and dispatch timing will be confirmed before the order is finalized.
How can I request a quotation?
Send your color and size quantities, total quantity, destination and packing requirements. We will confirm the order details and provide an order-specific quotation.
